phases.name: P01-P70 Verified Product Baseline
phases.objective: Preserve the existing production-ready Lead Engine implementation and its completed engineering milestones.
exit_criteria: P01-P70 remain represented by repository/checkpoint evidence and are not replayed.

phases.name: ANPOS 1.4.0 Adoption and Main Governance
phases.objective: Install and verify the ANPOS child control plane without replacing the product implementation.
exit_criteria: Main rules require validate and repository-integrity.

phases.name: Production Operations
phases.objective: Operate the daily US + Canada lead pipeline while preserving quota, taxonomy and exact R2 dedupe invariants.
exit_criteria: Daily quota evidence is reconciled from real runtime/workbook state.
External workbook-creation autonomy is certified or remains explicitly blocked.

phases.name: ANPOS Assurance and Coordination Hardening
phases.objective: Classify Requirements 83-96 and complete only governance capabilities supported by real identities/platform evidence.
exit_criteria: REQ-83-96 applicability classified with project-specific reasons/evidence.
Evidence-backed applicable requirements verified; REQ-90 external qualified review remains explicitly non-passed.
Supported GitHub governance/security capabilities are live and verified; identity/platform-dependent extensions remain explicitly deferred.

work_units.title: Preserve verified P01-P70 baseline
work_units.objective: Treat completed legacy milestones as historical verified work rather than replaying them under ANPOS.
acceptance_criteria: Legacy checkpoint and README retain the P01-P70 production baseline.
No completed product milestone is reset to not_started.
completion_evidence: PR #117 P70 evidence retained in history

work_units.title: Adopt and verify ANPOS child governance
work_units.objective: Install ANPOS 1.4.0 and align protected main with verified child quality checks.
acceptance_criteria: ANPOS repository validation passes.
Main ruleset is active with validate and repository-integrity.
Vendor-only boundary is clean.

work_units.title: Operate and verify daily 12,000-lead quota
work_units.objective: Continue bounded production runs until the dated workbook reaches the daily target without weakening quality/dedupe rules.
acceptance_criteria: Real dated workbook reaches 12,000 / 12,000 for the active date.
R2 pending recovery unresolved count is zero at certification.
No taxonomy or dedupe invariant is weakened.
required_checks: Successful real Lead Engine workflow evidence

work_units.title: Certify strict user-OAuth My Drive creation autonomy
work_units.objective: Prove a genuinely missing My Drive workbook can be created and trashed with the intended user OAuth path.
blockers: Human/external Google user authorization and strict create→trash certification evidence are not available in repository evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Strict Google Drive Capability create→trash probe succeeds with user OAuth.
No secret material is committed.
required_checks: Google Drive Capability strict user-OAuth certification

work_units.title: Classify ANPOS Requirements 83-96
work_units.objective: Set actual applicability/state/reasons for AI/product/governance assurance using VSN Lead Engine evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Every REQ-83 through REQ-96 has project-specific applicability and reason.
Applicable requirements reference real evidence or remain non-passed.
No policy-presence-only pass claims.

work_units.title: Enable independent protected-control-plane review
work_units.objective: Enforce CODEOWNER/one-review/last-push approval only after an independent reviewer/team exists.
blockers: No independent reviewer/team has been verified for safe enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Independent reviewer/team exists and can approve protected paths.
Ruleset is applied and re-read without self-review deadlock.

work_units.title: Protect ANPOS coordination ref namespaces
work_units.objective: Apply trusted-runtime restrictions to claims/** and supervisor/** only when supported and verifiable.
blockers: No verified persistent Supervisor/runtime identity and no verified coordination-ref rules capability/application evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Coordination refs are protected by verified trusted-runtime policy or an authenticated gateway fallback.
Live re-read proves enforcement.

work_units.title: Verify assurance evidence on immutable merged ref
work_units.objective: After classification/evidence merge, re-run child gates and mark only evidence-backed requirements passed.
acceptance_criteria: Applicable REQ-83-96 states match merged evidence.
All passed rows reference immutable merged ref/time.
REQ-90 remains verification_required until qualified legal/privacy review.

progress_note: ANPOS 1.4.0 adoption, assurance classification, supported security capabilities and active main governance are verified. Production quota work continues independently; identity/platform/legal external gates remain explicit.
